title: Add mesa.candidate_ref exact pinning
notes: WorktreeManager.resolve_ref resolves branch names, tags, and full/short commit SHAs read-only.
Candidate worktree is created directly from resolved 40-char SHA without switching or modifying the main checkout.
Main checkout HEAD, branch, and status are asserted unchanged across worktree lifecycle.
Invalid or unresolvable candidate refs fail explicitly with descriptive ValueError.
